entries.zh: 痨；痨病（痨瘵虚损之慢性消耗病）；亦指患痨之人
entries.en: consumptive; consumption, phthisis (wasting sickness); a consumptive person

entries.zh: 痨病；「系痨」谓是痨、患痨（首字 系/絲 存疑）
entries.en: consumptive; to be consumptive ('si-lo', first character uncertain: xi/si)
entries.notes: 首字音标污损难辨（T99）且有 系/絲 之疑；然 etico＋痨＋lō 三栏互证，仍可释义

entries.zh: 内伤（劳倦七情内损脏腑之虚损，久可成痨）
entries.en: internal injury; damage to the inner organs, wasting from within

entries.zh: 痨瘵消瘦，身体干枯（汉字「拴身/惜身」存疑，或读「惜身」保养身体）
entries.en: consumptive, with the body wasted/emaciated; (Hokkien tsio-sin possibly 'to cherish the body')
entries.notes: 西语 secoya 为 17 世纪非常规拼写（疑即 seco ya『身体已干枯』），汉字拴/惜存疑，故降置信
非词条：四栏为字母分节标记 E／ante／U（与页眉 E. ante. U. V. 同款），无词义可对释

entries.zh: 现现；显然可见、显露无隐（承上 evidente 之叠字对译）
entries.en: evident; plainly visible, manifest; clearly revealed

entries.notes: 非词条：四栏为字母分节标记 E／ante／V（与页眉 E. ante. U. V. 同款），无词义可对释

entries.zh: 阉割（割去玉茎，即男根）；谓阉人为太监
entries.en: to castrate (cut off the penis, yu-ching 'jade stalk'); of eunuchs
entries.notes: 「玉」字音标污损难辨（T99）且有 玉莖/王脛 之疑；玉莖（giok-kèng）指男根，与西语 castran（阉割）相合

entries.en: eunuch of the palace; palace eunuch
